name: Indian Springs Center
summary: Indian Springs Center is a 140,384 square foot community shopping center anchored by H.E.B. in the heart of The Woodlands, Texas. Serving an exceptionally affluent trade area with average household incomes over $208,000, the center attracts 2.6 million annual visits from residents and nearby employees.
demographics: Indian Springs Center serves an affluent suburban market in The Woodlands, with households within 3 miles averaging $208,664 in annual income and home values of $637,359. The trade area population of 78,610 residents consists primarily of upper-middle-class families and professionals, with over 65,000 employees working within 5 miles of the center. The daytime population of 63,893 includes a strong contingency of working professionals who frequent the center for convenience shopping and dining. Typical visitors are educated, high-income households seeking quality grocery shopping at H.E.B. and convenient access to services, with shopping patterns reflecting a preference for one-stop convenience in an upscale master-planned community setting.
description: Indian Springs Center is a premier community shopping destination located in the heart of The Woodlands, Texas, one of the nation's best-selling master-planned communities. Anchored by the popular H.E.B. grocery store, this 140,384 square foot center serves as a vital retail hub for the affluent surrounding neighborhoods, attracting over 2.6 million annual visits from residents and the 65,000+ employees working within a 5-mile radius. The center is strategically positioned along Kuykendahl Road, providing convenient access to a trade area characterized by exceptional demographics, including average household incomes exceeding $208,000 and home values approaching $640,000. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, Indian Springs Center exemplifies the company's commitment to creating thriving neighborhood shopping experiences that cater to the daily needs of upscale suburban communities. With its strong anchor tenant, convenient location, and service to one of Texas's most desirable residential markets, Indian Springs Center continues to be a cornerstone of retail activity in The Woodlands area.
